page.layout: One printed page on the left: running head at top; woodcut ornament; heading "LOCI S. SCRIPTURAE VINDICATIO" with a two-column table of Scripture references and page numbers at right; rule below; "Emendanda" errata list; ornament at foot. Right edge shows part of the facing page (show-through or neighbouring page edge, not transcribed).
page.notes: The table's page numbers at right are partly worn; "p. 123" and "p.95" and "p.24" readings are uncertain. The right-hand page edge shows fragments of a facing page ("A", "I", "II", "Li", "CH") which are not transcribed. Ornaments (woodcut and foot fleuron) are not text.
